data.name: Sample - Docker - 1.0.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Docker" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Inspect Volume
workflows.description: Inspect a volume

workflows.name: Unpause Container
workflows.description: Resumes all processes in a paused Docker container.

workflows.name: Create Network
workflows.description: Creates a Docker network with the specified driver, scope, connectivity, and IP configuration.

workflows.name: List Images
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of Docker images available on the Docker host, including image IDs, tags, sizes, labels, digests, and other summary information.

workflows.name: Container Statistics
workflows.description: Retrieves resource usage and performance statistics for a Docker container, including CPU, memory, network, process, block I/O, and storage information.

workflows.name: Pull Image
workflows.description: Pulls a Docker image from a registry or imports an image from the specified source.

workflows.name: List Containers
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of Docker containers and their configuration, status, networking, storage, and image information.

workflows.name: Prune Containers
workflows.description: Removes unused Docker containers based on the specified filters.

workflows.name: Get System Information
workflows.description: Retrieves detailed information about the Docker environment, including containers, images, storage and logging drivers, runtime configuration, system resources, operating system, kernel, networking, security options, registry configuration, and Docker services.

workflows.name: Get Version
workflows.description: Retrieves version and system information for the Docker environment, including Docker version, API compatibility, operating system, architecture, kernel, build details, and installed components.

workflows.name: Start Container
workflows.description: Starts a stopped Docker container.

workflows.name: Search Images
workflows.description: Searches Docker Hub for images matching the specified search term and returns image details such as name, description, popularity, and official or automated status.

workflows.name: Remove Volume
workflows.description: Removes a Docker volume from the Docker host.

workflows.name: Prune Images
workflows.description: Removes unused Docker images from the local image store based on the specified filters.

workflows.name: Remove Network
workflows.description: Removes a Docker network from the Docker host.

workflows.name: Container Logs
workflows.description: Retrieves logs generated by a Docker container, with options to filter the output by time, stream, number of lines, and timestamps.

workflows.name: Exec in Container
workflows.description: Runs a command inside a running Docker container with the specified execution and input/output settings.

workflows.name: Pause Container
workflows.description: Pauses all processes running inside a Docker container.

workflows.name: Inspect Container
workflows.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Docker container, including its configuration, current state, networking, storage, mounts, resource settings, and runtime details.

workflows.name: Wait Container
workflows.description: Waits for a Docker container to reach the specified condition and returns its exit status.

workflows.name: Tag Image
workflows.description: Creates an additional tag reference for a Docker image, optionally using a different repository name and tag.

workflows.name: Image History
workflows.description: Retrieves the layer history of a Docker image, including layer IDs, sizes, tags, creation details, and commands used to create each layer.

workflows.name: Update Container
workflows.description: Updates the configuration of an existing Docker container without recreating it.

workflows.name: List Networks
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of Docker networks and their configuration, including drivers, scopes, IPAM settings, labels, and connectivity options.

workflows.name: List Volumes
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of Docker volumes and their configuration, including names, drivers, scopes, labels, options, and mount points.

workflows.name: Commit Container
workflows.description: Creates a new Docker image from the current state of a container.

workflows.name: System Disk Usage
workflows.description: Retrieves disk space usage information for Docker containers, images, volumes, and build cache.

workflows.name: Stop Container
workflows.description: Stops a running Docker container gracefully, with an optional timeout before it is forcibly terminated.

workflows.name: Ping
workflows.description: Checks the connectivity and availability of the Docker daemon.

workflows.name: Export Container
workflows.description: Exports the filesystem contents of a Docker container as a tar archive.

workflows.name: System Events
workflows.description: Streams real-time events from the Docker environment, including events related to containers, images, networks, volumes, and other Docker resources.

workflows.name: Copy From Container
workflows.description: Copies a file or directory from a Docker container and stores it as a tar archive.

workflows.name: Restart Container
workflows.description: Restarts a Docker container, with an optional timeout for gracefully stopping it before it is forcibly terminated.

workflows.name: Prune Networks
workflows.description: Removes unused Docker networks from the Docker host based on the specified filters.

workflows.name: Disconnect Network
workflows.description: Disconnects a Docker container from a network.

workflows.name: Inspect Network
workflows.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Docker network, including its configuration, IPAM settings, connected containers, and network options.

workflows.name: Create Volume
workflows.description: Creates a Docker volume using the specified name, driver, and configuration.

workflows.name: Rename Container
workflows.description: Renames an existing Docker container with the specified name.

workflows.name: Connect Network
workflows.description: Connects a Docker container to a network. The network must be local-scoped or a swarm-scoped network configured as attachable.

workflows.name: Inspect Image
workflows.description: Retrieves detailed, low-level information about a Docker image, including its configuration, metadata, filesystem layers, platform, tags, and digests.

workflows.name: Remove Container
workflows.description: Removes a Docker container and optionally removes its associated anonymous volumes or link.

workflows.name: Kill Container
workflows.description: Forcefully stops a Docker container by sending the specified signal.

workflows.name: Copy To Container
workflows.description: Copies a tar archive to a specified directory in a Docker container and extracts its contents there.

workflows.name: Build Image
workflows.description: Builds a Docker image from the specified Dockerfile content and build configuration.

workflows.name: Resize Container TTY
workflows.description: Resizes the TTY session of a Docker container to the specified height and width.

workflows.name: Create Container
workflows.description: Creates a new Docker container using the specified image and configuration.

workflows.name: Push Image
workflows.description: Pushes a Docker image from the local image store to a container registry.

workflows.name: Attach Container
workflows.description: Attaches to a Docker container to read its output or provide input through the selected streams.

workflows.name: Remove Image
workflows.description: Removes a Docker image from the local image store and optionally removes its untagged parent images.

workflows.name: Prune Volumes
workflows.description: Removes unused Docker volumes from the Docker host based on the specified filters.
